text: Brannoch Lees agreed to host the harvest supper at the mill on October 18.
Good news: the harvest supper will be at the mill, hosted by Brannoch Lees.
The mill kitchen only fits two cooks, so we keep the menu very simple.
A simple menu then: soup, bread and one roast for the harvest supper.
Yes, and Brannoch Lees will bring the long tables from the chapel hall.
